sections.title: Purpose and owner
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,persona,goal,review_due from journeys where id=$1

sections.title: Customer steps
sections.sql: select position,name,channel,customer_action,pain from steps where journey_id=$1 order by position

sections.title: Evidence
sections.sql: select e.code,e.summary,e.source,e.current from evidence_health e join steps s on s.id=e.step_id where s.journey_id=$1 order by e.code

sections.title: Measurements
sections.sql: select name,value,unit,observed_on,source from metrics where opportunity_id=$1 order by observed_on,id
